_note: The dark trailer SFX set (ElevenLabs Sound Effects, model eleven_text_to_sound_v2, 2 variants each). The picked files ship in assets/sfx/dark/. Regenerate only for a different mood; get_sfx.py maps a generation to its name by the 'match' words.
